title: Cross-Skill Handoff Envelope
description: Unified handoff structure when one skill completes and another starts. Borrowed from seo-geo-claude-skills. Every skill terminal output should conform to this if it triggers a downstream skill.

objective.description: 1-line summary of what THIS skill set out to do

evidence_summary.description: Brief synthesis of evidence supporting findings

open_loops.description: Things this skill couldn't resolve and downstream should pick up

cite_scores.description: 4 CITE dimensions: Citation / Identity / Trust / Eminence

priority_items.description: Ordered list of next actions (most important first)

recommended_next_skill.description: Slug of the next skill to invoke (or 'NONE' if pipeline complete)

artifacts_written.description: Relative paths of files this skill wrote (for audit trail)
